reviews.t: Takes so little to do a GREAT job!
reviews.x: Love this stuff!! Was recommended to me several years ago. Will not be without it. Have very fine hair and works so well with not a large quantity needed to do the job. Not only cheaper on Amazon but has been hard to find in my local salons. So convenient to have shipped to the door.

reviews.t: If you have super fine unmanageable hair
reviews.x: If you have super fine unmanageable hair, you will love this stuff.  It holds without using an excessive amount.  It has sort of a grapefruit fragrance.

Best hairspray ever! This hairspray has been great, but it is not easy to find in stores and can be expensive. This pack that shipped from the UK was a great price and came fast.  I have very fine hair that tends to have a hard time staying in place. When I spray many others it messes up my hair just spraying. This one does not do that and it holds all day. I can't figure out what is different about this one. It doesn't leave that crusty hard feeling either. Not sure what I would do without it.

reviews.t: This order is really weird and not good..
reviews.x: This most recent purchase of the hair spray must be an imitation of the real stuff...I noticed that the bottle had some differences from other ones I have bought. There was missing a little symbol to the right of the words BED HEAD. This order is really weird and not good...I maybe will attempt to return the 2 bottles I bought.
I have been using this hairspray for several years now.  Ordering it and having it arrive on my doorstep is just too convenient to pass up!

reviews.t: it smells very good, it's light but holds very well
reviews.x: i don't use any other hair spray since i've tried this one. it smells very good, it's light but holds very well. and brushes off so you don't have to wash your hair right away. great product!

reviews.t: Great hair spray for the price
reviews.x: Super sticky hair spray! And very easy to work with as it's a liquid, so I can put it on my fingers and work in into particular areas of the hair. The only issue is the bottle is prone to leaking (only a little!) when traveling, so try and keep it upright and in a plastic bag. One of the two had leaked a little in the initial shipment, too. But overall great product that is long lasting. Not the biggest fan of the grapefruit smell, but it lessens over time. Also, I got two regular sized bottles

This is my most favourite hairspray to lock in styles after moulding with styling clay or wax.  Decent hold and gives a slight matte finish.  The scent is awesome.  Can’t describe it...smells fruity?  IDK but I want to drink it lol.  The shipping is a bit long as it travels far for me (live in US, ships from Europe) but I usually order when I’m half way on my current bottle and it arrives way before I run out.  Second time I’ve ordered from this buyer and will keep ordering in the near future.

reviews.t: Problem with sprayer. 2 out of 3 did not work
reviews.x: I love the product, and the scent, however, the last time I ordered this the sprayer did not work. I just ordered and received my new order of 2 and the first thing I did was check the sprayer. One of them worked and one of them did not work!! So 2 out of 3 bought didn't work.

After using this product I realized that it was expired or not real due to the lack of hold, and the stickiness in my hair.  I took the product to my hairdresser who agreed.  The color of the hairspray was yellow as opposed to clear. Very disappointed!

I love this hairspray, It's the only one that holds my thin hair in place. It's definitely a firm hold so if you're looking for light hold this wouldn't be for you but I don't know what I would do without it! Only positives to say about the seller.

I love this product maxxed out hairspray , been using it for years!!! It has been discontinued by the company and cannot find another product I like as well! Price has been jacked up ridiculously… Why Why please bring it back?????

I use this because it is not heavy on my hair. It does not dry my hair out, like others I have tried. I also like that once I fix my hair and spray, my hair stays in place even on a Nebraska windy day!

reviews.t: The best hairspray on the market
reviews.x: I have been using this product for years.  It does great in a dry and humid climate.  I wouldn’t use anything else.  The best thing about this hairspray is that it doesn’t weigh down your hair.

reviews.t: great product at a great price
reviews.x: I love this product. And so happy to see it on Amazon at an amazing price. I have ordered  before and always been satisfied. The product is great and the shipping time is very quick. Thanks.

reviews.t: ... make my scalp itch -- Bed Head has worked wonderfully and I like the hold formula that keep my ...
reviews.x: Needed to change hair spray from Matrix Biolage to something that didn't make my scalp itch -- Bed Head has worked wonderfully and I like the hold formula that keep my style in place.

reviews.t: Delivered on time and in great shape! Price was great
reviews.x: AS always,  Bed Head Maxxed Out Massive Hold is everything I want in control for my hair,  as well as pleasant fragrance.  Delivered on time and in great shape!  Price was great!
Love most Bed Head products, and I have many.  However, this one ranks at the bottom.  I don't find that it holds my hair very well at all.  I  would not purchase again.
Nice hold, product does what it claims, which is unusual now days. Best product for my hair and i tried many many other sprays that DID NOT WORK, this is a keeper
I have found that this is the only product that will hold my spikey hair!! LOVE it!! Could not find it in stores so HAD to order it because nothing else works!

reviews.t: This is my favorite hair product
reviews.x: This is my favorite hair product! Long lasting flexible hold. Doesn't dry to white dust like other hairsprays. Smells good!
the best non-aerosol hairspray IMO. Pleasant smell. Only thing I don't like is that I cannot find it locally anywhere
My second order of this hair spray.  Holds my fine hair all day, but doesn't look like my hair has anything on it.
This is better than hair spray!! Keeps the style the way you want it. Washes out easy and clean. Smells very nice.
Love this hairspray. It's all I use. Awesome smell and great hold. Non-sticky, non-flaky and holds up in humidity

claims.text: Reviewers with fine or thin hair say it holds styles well without needing much product or weighing hair down.
Many reviewers have used it for years and praise its strong hold and pleasant fruity scent.
Reviewers appreciate the convenient, fast shipping and good price on Amazon, though some note it's hard to find in stores.
Some reviewers suspect counterfeit or expired product, citing lack of hold, stickiness, yellow color, or bottle differences.
A few reviewers report defective sprayers or leaking bottles.
